name: Lvgl → Pause
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#actions-action) pauses the activity of LVGL, including rendering.

config_entries.label: Lvgl ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the LVGL instance to pause.

config_entries.label: Show Snow
config_entries.description: When paused, display random colored pixels across the entire screen in order to minimize screen burn-in, to relief the tension put on each individual pixel. See [Prevent burn-in of LCD](https://esphome.io/cookbook/lvgl#lvgl-cookbook-antiburn) for an example which demonstrates how to use this.
